---
name: code-review
description: Audit a pull request for plan alignment, correctness, regressions, security, compatibility, tests, documentation, and release risk.
---

Read the complete diff, active plan, linked work, required checks, review threads, dependency changes, and affected documentation.

Prioritize genuine defects and missing verification. Check logical side safety, state migrations, network authority, permission gates, path handling, workflow trust, secrets, and artifact integrity.

Report precise actionable findings. Avoid style noise. Recheck material pushes before resolving a finding.
